cost_model: single_target restates pnl with a 1% fee and 0.5% slippage per side; ladder_e applies that fee and slippage in the fill

headline.readout_statement: The refit readout does not beat the majority class out of sample.

previous_gated_window.note: Same clock as the gated holdout from 2026-11-05T04:00:00Z through snapshots/2026-11-05/0800.jsonl. Voters use only outcomes that ended before that open. Not used to choose the horizon or the gate.

readout_oos.statement: The refit readout does not beat the majority class out of sample.

selection_rule: On train folds only, among configs with at least one closed trade, pick the highest pnl after modeled costs. Ties prefer more closes, then the primary-vote gate on, then the shorter horizon. The holdout fold is not an input. A policy with no closed train trade keeps horizon 300000 ms and the primary-vote gate on.

voters.crow: refilled from rows whose outcome_end_ms is before the fold start
voters.flyvis: refit on decisions whose outcome_end_ms is before the fold start
voters.holder_reads: joined at the decision when read_ts_ms is at or before it; not a readout label
voters.pool_trades: joined at the decision when read_ts_ms is at or before it; the entry veto stays off
